summary: Selected agent card folds, including direct resource folds, pages and chunks, now pin a read snapshot when called outside a request, matching full-roster and exact-agent folds so scheduling pauses do not turn a known mailbox fault into fault status unknown.

replay.detail: No graph replay or backfill; faults are read at the same cut.

schema.detail: No database, claim kind, claim field or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No authority, write-rule, checkpoint or coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Request reads retain their enclosing budget and existing snapshots are reused. Only direct selected-card callers outside both now pin, using the existing pinned fault-read policy. No deadline values or response shapes change.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no member ordering is required.

recovery.detail: Revert the binary to restore the previous in-memory read behavior; no data migration is needed.
